H2_calibration.quote: Do not rely on ambiguity to protect flagship work. Training above 10^26 operations in a single run is clearly covered by Sec. 2(1)(A) and Sec. 3(a). The drafting problems are mostly at the edges, and a regulator or court would likely read the core prohibition as applying to frontier training.

H1_holdback.quote: Arguments that depend on structuring entities abroad, splitting runs across facilities, or labeling training as evaluation could be framed as evasion. The bill has no anti-evasion language, but raising these gaps may prompt one to be added, which would hurt us.
